id: ESTCMP2 + AM: (1) offline estimator comparison on pelvis-IMU logs including the tuned momentum observer; (2) robustness to the robot's own arm motion, offline (all estimators on the same logs) and in closed loop (DB vs DBMOB)
registered: 2026-10-27, before any run of this dataset. Logging change only (run_brace OBS2 log adds all 29 motor torques and the tick; no control change). Earlier ESTCMP (torso-IMU OBS2 logs, exploratory) is not reused
plant_controller: final controller DB (as HFDB) in control for the dataset; pelvis IMU; synchronous; noise moderate; OBS2_LOG on

cells.arm_jab / arm_swing / arm_lift / arm_ges: no push; upper body replays the ACCAD motion (run_um.sh keys) from 2 s, looped; lower body unaware

estimators (offline, causal replay on th.SME: original waist SME (logged ctrl.dist.raw of the IMU-SME arm's base SME is not available) -> re-run LowerMomentumS (gain 100) on the logged inputs (obs2_est.replay_A)
estimators (offline, causal replay on th.IMUSME: ours (obs2_est branch B with the pelvis-IMU model)
estimators (offline, causal replay on th.MOB: tuned momentum observer as in the controller (codex_mob.robust.MOB2Disturbance, gain 30, tau 0.1, release_grace 0.1), all 29 motor torques
estimators (offline, causal replay on th.CIMU: IMU base acceleration, joint accelerations set to 0 (centroidal + IMU principle)
estimators (offline, causal replay on th.EMO: SME + lead + Kalman filter, measurement noise set on the calibration seed for the same quiet noise floor as IMUSME (as ESTCMP)

metrics.noise floor: 2-tick max |d_fast| (slow 0.5 s component removed) in 1.0-2.95 s of quiet runs
metrics.threshold: theta = max(25 N, 1.1 x calibration noise floor), per estimator
metrics.latency: first 2-tick crossing of theta after 3.0 s on push_x and push_y
metrics.transient error: q99.5 |true - estimate| (xy) in 3.0-3.5 s on push cells
metrics.arm false triggers: per arm run: any 2-tick |d_fast| > theta in 2.0-10 s; and max 2-tick |d_fast| / theta

offline decisions.A1 (own-motion rejection): IMUSME: no false trigger in any of the 12 test arm runs
offline decisions.A2 (vs simpler models): false-trigger runs IMUSME < CIMU and IMUSME <= MOB (reported counts)
offline decisions.D1 (vs tuned MOB, detection): median latency IMUSME <= MOB - 10 ms with IMUSME noise floor <= MOB noise floor

closed loop AM.arms: DB (dataset runs) vs DBMOB (DB with MOBP, RA2E_THR 25) on the 12 test arm runs
closed loop AM.metrics: falls, steps, hold-mode entries (est_on rising edges) during 2-10 s
closed loop AM.decision C1: DB: no fall and no step in any of the 12 arm runs
